boundary_notice: The greatest risks for pilots are thresholds and cycles, not AI. AI cannot take your cockpit, but medical certification, licenses, and market swings can change your career path at any time.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: This role does not suit people who fail medical standards, act impulsively, or avoid responsibility. Flight has extremely little room for error, and one rash decision or failed medical exam can end a career.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is airline recruitment through a civil aviation flight program or sponsored training, or self-funded flight school, followed by a private pilot license, commercial license, and instrument rating, accumulated flight hours, employment at an airline or general aviation company, and rigorous progression from first officer to captain.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This career suits calm, healthy people who follow procedures. You must work through checklists under pressure, remain emotionally steady, resist fatigue, and have strong hands-on and spatial abilities. English is also a firm requirement, especially on international routes.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you have looked up to the cockpit since childhood and can patiently follow procedures, flying offers a career with high investment, high returns, and strong professional pride.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Calm: follow procedures under pressure
Compliance: never skip a checklist step
Decisiveness: judge quickly in abnormal situations
Strong health: meet strict medical standards
Teamwork: coordinate smoothly with the crew

boundary_notice: 飞行员最大的风险不是 AI，而是「门槛与周期」——AI 抢不走你的驾驶舱，但体检、执照和市场波动，随时可能改写你的职业轨迹。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合身体条件不达标、沉不住气、怕负责任的人。飞行容错率极低，一次冲动或一次体检不合格，就可能断送职业生涯。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：通过招飞（民航飞行技术专业/航空公司委培）或自费学飞 → 获取私照、商照、仪表等级 → 攒飞行小时数 → 入职航空公司或通航公司 → 从副驾驶晋升机长，经历严格训练和考核。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合冷静、守规程、身体好的人。你要能在压力下按检查单一步步走，情绪稳定、抗疲劳，动手能力和空间感都要强；英语也是硬要求，国际航线更是离不开。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你从小仰望驾驶舱、又能沉得住气守住规程，飞行会给你一条高投入、高回报、高荣誉感的职业路。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 冷静：压力下按规程走
守规：检查单一步不跳
决断力：特情下快速判断
身体好：体检标准严格
协作力：机组配合默契

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is not AI alone, but heavy responsibility + narrow skills. Workers who only scan slides without adding interpretation and quality control face displacement.
This fit assessment is a theoretical, probabilistic aid for self-evaluation. It is not deterministic, and individual differences are substantial.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: This work is a poor fit for careless people who dislike repeated cultures or avoid report responsibility. Cytogenetic Technologists follow time-sensitive cultures and verify results repeatedly; errors can mislead diagnosis.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: earn an associate degree in medical laboratory science or biology → enter a genetics laboratory as a technician → obtain a laboratory credential → perform karyotyping independently → become a Supervising Technologist.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This work suits detail-oriented people who can remain focused, enjoy laboratory work, and accept professional responsibility. If your standard is an accurate chromosome count and clear structure, you can build a stable path here.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you are detail-oriented, can remain focused, and treat clear karyotypes as the standard, cytogenetics offers meaningful entry into medical laboratory work. Use this fit guidance for career exploration, not as a diagnosis or a hiring or employment decision.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This fit assessment is a theoretical, probabilistic aid for self-evaluation. It is not deterministic, and individual differences are substantial.
traits: Detail: count accurately
Composure: maintain cultures
Laboratory skill: operate confidently
Responsibility: prevent false reports
Interpretation: use trained visual judgment

boundary_notice: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「责任重 + 技能单一」——不补判读与质控，只扫片会被 AI 吃。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：医学检验或生物大专 → 进遗传实验室当技术员 → 考检验资格 → 独立做核型 → 成主管技师。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合细致、坐得住、对实验室有兴趣也扛得住责任的人。你把「条数准、结构清」当标准，这行就稳。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你细致、坐得住、把「核型排清楚」当标准，细胞遗传是医学检验里很有价值感的入口。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

沉稳：守培养

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is AI itself. Classification, extraction, and filing can be automated, compressing document roles that remain at the execution layer. Advancement into governance and compliance is necessary.

This fit assessment is a theoretical, probabilistic aid for career exploration and self-evaluation. It is not deterministic, and individual differences are substantial. Do not use it as a diagnostic, hiring, or employment decision.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: This career is a poor fit for people who only want to organize files quietly and avoid meetings. The hard part is not filing documents but getting an entire company to follow shared rules. Weak communication and coordination create constant obstacles.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common route starts with a degree in archival studies, information management, or library and information science, followed by archival or document-control work. Specialists then learn ECM/DMS platforms and workflow design, develop compliance and business knowledge, and move into content governance, knowledge management, or compliance management.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This career suits logical, detail-oriented people who communicate well. Strong specialists design classification and access systems, then persuade departments to follow the rules. Document governance depends on that combination of technical structure and organizational influence.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you enjoy turning disorder into order and want to specialize in compliance and governance, document management can develop you into a trusted guardian of enterprise knowledge.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This fit assessment is a theoretical, probabilistic aid for career exploration and self-evaluation. It is not deterministic, and individual differences are substantial. Do not use it as a diagnostic, hiring, or employment decision.
traits: Logical thinking: classification and rule design
Attention and patience: metadata and standards
Compliance awareness: protect hard boundaries
Communication and influence: secure cooperation across departments
Learning ability: keep pace with fast-changing AI tools

boundary_notice: 最大的职业风险就是 AI 本身——分类、提取、归档都能自动化，停在执行层的文档管理岗会最先被压缩，必须向治理与合规升级。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合只想「默默整理文件」、讨厌开会协调的人。文档管理的难点从来不在整理，而在让全公司的人遵守规则——不擅长沟通协调的人会寸步难行。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：档案学/信息管理/图书情报相关专业 → 档案管理或文控岗位做起 → 掌握文档管理系统（ECM/DMS）与流程设计 → 积累合规与业务知识 → 向内容治理、知识管理或合规管理方向发展。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合逻辑清晰、心细、能跟人打交道的人。你既能设计分类和权限体系，也能说服各部门按规则用系统，把「管文件」这件事做得让人愿意配合，这行需要这种复合能力。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你享受「把混乱变有序」的掌控感，又愿意往合规与治理方向深耕，文档管理会把你锻造成企业离不开的「知识守门人」。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 逻辑清晰：分类与规则设计
细致耐心：元数据与规范
合规意识：红线守得住
沟通推动：让各部门配合
学习能力：AI 工具迭代快

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is not AI but falling behind technical change. AI diagnostics replace standard procedures, while technicians who cannot keep pace with connected and new-energy vehicle technology face the real displacement risk.

This fit assessment is a theoretical, probabilistic aid for career exploration and self-evaluation. It is not deterministic, and individual differences are substantial. Do not use it as a diagnostic, hiring, or employment decision.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: This occupation is a poor fit for people who are careless, fear electrical work, or resist technical change. Vehicle electronics involve low-voltage harnesses and body networks. One incorrect connection can damage a module, making carelessness and stagnant skills serious risks.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is: automotive electronics, automotive repair, or electronic technology program → apprenticeship at a repair shop, dealership, or electronics customization shop → proficiency with vehicle electrical systems and diagnostic tools → automotive electrical-repair or related qualification → electronics repair technician, technical supervisor, or customization-shop owner.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This occupation suits people with strong hands-on ability who enjoy working with circuits. You should be able to read wiring diagrams, trace a harness to its endpoint, and keep learning new vehicle platforms and equipment.

personality_fit_block.callout: For people who enjoy circuits, tolerate oily workshops, and keep learning new vehicles and technologies, automotive electronics repair offers a skilled-trades path where deeper expertise creates more value.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This fit assessment is a theoretical, probabilistic aid for career exploration and self-evaluation. It is not deterministic, and individual differences are substantial. Do not use it as a diagnostic, hiring, or employment decision.
traits: Circuit fundamentals: read diagrams, route wiring, and measure voltage
Hands-on ability: precise disassembly and neat wire routing
Troubleshooting patience: trace a harness to its endpoint
Learning ability: keep pace with new vehicles and protocols
Responsibility: secure connections and complete testing

boundary_notice: 汽车电子维修工最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「技术迭代的断层」——AI 诊断替代的是标准流程，而跟不上智能网联和新能源技术的人，才是真正被行业淘汰的。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合粗心大意、怕电、抗拒技术更新的人。汽车电子涉及低压线束和车身网络，接错一根线可能烧掉模块，粗心和停步不前都是大忌。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：汽车电子、汽车维修、电子技术类专业 → 在汽修店、4S 店或电子改装店学徒 → 熟悉车载电气系统与诊断工具 → 考取汽车维修电工或相关资格 → 向电子维修技师、技术主管或改装店老板发展。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合动手能力强、喜欢跟电路打交道的人。你能看懂电路图，能顺着线束一查到底，能接受不断学习新车型新设备，这行欢迎你。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你喜欢电路、不排斥油污车间、又愿意持续学新车型新技术，汽车电子维修是一条技能越深越值钱的蓝领技术路线。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
traits: 电路功底：识图、走线、测电压
动手能力：拆装精细、走线工整
排查耐心：顺着线束一查到底
学习力：新车型新协议跟上
责任心：接线牢固、测试到位

boundary_notice: The greatest career risk is not AI but systems absorbing appointment and clerical back-office work. People with strong companionship and on-site skills become more resilient.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: Not suited to people who avoid heavy subjects, cannot tolerate emotional settings, or work carelessly. Daily exposure to farewells makes emotional fragility and inattention difficult to sustain.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path begins with an apprenticeship at a funeral home, followed by work as a funeral arranger, independent responsibility for families, advancement into a lead role, and eventually funeral home management.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: Best suited to composed, attentive people who remain grounded in emotionally intense settings. If handling difficult matters thoroughly is your standard, this career can be a strong fit.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you are composed, attentive, and committed to handling difficult matters thoroughly, funeral arranging is one of the most personally demanding entry points in the service sector.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

Attention to detail: keep documents accurate

Resilience: remain steady on site

boundary_notice: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「预约 + 文书」后台被系统吃，有陪伴力与现场力的人反而更稳。

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合怕沉重、受不了情绪场、做事粗糙的人。这行天天碰告别，玻璃心与马虎都难做。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：殡仪馆学徒 → 做丧葬安排员 → 独立跟家庭 → 做承办人 → 做殡仪馆经理。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合沉稳、细致、能在情绪场里站稳的人。你愿意把「把难事办周全」当标准，这行就稳。

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: This occupation does not suit careless people, those uncomfortable working alone or at night, or anyone insensitive to equipment sounds. Stations are often remote, and mistakes can have serious consequences.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path starts as an apprentice or operator, advances through supervised work and independent control-room monitoring, then moves into station responsibility, dispatch, or station management.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This occupation suits careful, steady people who notice equipment behavior and can work night shifts. A strong operator treats safe, stable operation as the standard.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you are careful, steady, sensitive to equipment behavior, and committed to safe operations, compressor-station work provides strong training in the energy sector.

boundary_notice: The greatest risks are scarce positions and high-pressure evaluation, not AI. AI changes research methods but cannot change the reality of faculty competition.
This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: It does not suit people seeking easy stability. A doctorate takes at least five years, up-or-out evaluation creates pressure, publications are demanding, and faculty competition is intense. Reality is harsh for those prioritizing security.
fit_decision_checklist.how: A common path is a history bachelor's degree, master's and doctorate including overseas study, publications and project participation, then a lecturer or assistant-professor role. Professional titles and grants gradually create stability, with a few advancing to academic leadership.
fit_decision_checklist.suit: This role suits people who genuinely love reading, can endure long solitary work, and can command a classroom. They spend entire days in archives yet make a dry institutional history come alive for students.

personality_fit_block.callout: If you are willing to spend ten years developing a research question that truly belongs to you, postsecondary history teaching offers a lifetime of learning.
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: This match is a theoretical, probabilistic reference, not a deterministic judgment. Individual differences are significant. Use it only as a self-assessment aid.
traits: Reading endurance: handles long documents and sources
Logical argument: explains causation and evidence

Patience: revises student papers repeatedly

boundary_notice: 高校历史教师最大的风险不是 AI，而是「岗位稀缺 + 考核高压」——AI 改变的是研究方式，改变不了教职竞争的现实。
该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合想「轻松稳定」的人。博士五年起步、非升即走的考核、发论文的压力，加上高校教职竞争激烈，图安稳的人来这行会被现实教育得很惨。
fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：历史学本科 → 硕士、博士（含海外深造）→ 发表论文、参与课题 → 应聘高校教职（讲师/助理教授）→ 评职称、拿课题，逐步稳定，少数走向学术带头人。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合真喜欢读书、坐得住冷板凳、又能站上讲台的人。你既能在档案馆一坐一整天，也能在课堂上把一个枯燥的制度史讲得让学生瞪大眼睛。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你愿意用十年时间换来「一个真正属于自己的研究问题」，高校历史教师会给你一辈子都在学习的生活。

personality_fit_block.callout: Kindergarten teaching is a warm, front-line entry into education for people who are patient and committed to helping children grow safely.

fit_decision_checklist.boundary: 不适合没耐心、受不了家长群、扛不住安全责任的人。幼师常早出晚归、消息不断、担责重，玻璃心会很难受。

fit_decision_checklist.how: 常见路径是：HR/培训起步 → 做培训专员 → 独立管项目 → 负责培训体系 → 做培训与发展经理或 OD 负责人。
fit_decision_checklist.suit: 适合结构化、善沟通、能扛业务压的人。你愿意把「让人真正长本事」当标准，这行就稳。

personality_fit_block.callout: 如果你善沟通、结构化、把「让人真正长本事」当标准，培训经理是 HR 圈最练人的入口。
personality_fit_block.disclaimer: 该匹配为理论性、概率性参考，非决定论判断，个体差异显著，仅作自我评估辅助
